## Visualization Document

Working document for all of the visualizations used for the DS-403 (Digital Humanities) project. Parsing in text data, for analysis of thematic patterns throughout the various translations of Homer's *The Odyssey*.

## Working Through Code

Loading Libraries and figuring out how to parse text data in Rstudio.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(bayesrules)
library(janitor)
library(e1071)
library(tidytext)
library(ggplot2)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
